results.corrected_title: Google brings Gmail's AI Inbox and new Gmail Live voice search to paid Workspace users in the US
results.corrected_summary: On 15 October 2026 Google said that AI Inbox, which first launched in Gmail earlier in 2026, is expanding to paid Google Workspace users. It began rolling out to Rapid Release domains on 12 October, and Scheduled Release domains follow from 26 October. The same day Google announced Gmail Live, a voice feature for Android and iOS: users ask questions out loud and Gemini answers from their email, showing a card that links to the source message. Both features are limited to US users with US English as their language.
key_facts: Google announced both features on the Workspace Updates blog on 15 October 2026
AI Inbox reached Rapid Release domains on 12 October and reaches Scheduled Release domains from 26 October, each with up to 15 days to become visible
Gmail Live has rolled out to Rapid and Scheduled Release domains since 15 October, on mobile only (Android and iOS)
Gmail Live is on by default for organisations with Gemini in Workspace access
Both features are limited to US users with EN-US as their language
AI Inbox itself first launched in Gmail earlier in 2026; what is new is the expansion to paid Workspace editions
results.issues: AI Inbox is not brand new. It launched in Gmail earlier in 2026, and only the paid-Workspace rollout falls inside the window. Google's edition list is internally inconsistent: Starter and Education editions are listed as eligible but also said to get AI Inbox later, and the help page still calls it an Enterprise Plus beta. Gmail Live is also offered to consumer Google AI Plus, Pro and Ultra subscribers, not just Workspace.

results.corrected_title: Notion 3.8 opens workspaces to any MCP-compatible agent and syncs Skills to ChatGPT and Claude
results.corrected_summary: Notion released version 3.8 on 13 October 2026. Any MCP-compatible agent can now read workspace context and update docs and task trackers, and admins get new controls to see, limit and revoke these connections. A new Skills API syncs Skills across ChatGPT, Claude and other agents and loads them into GitHub. ChatGPT Plus and Pro subscribers on Notion Business and Enterprise plans can use their ChatGPT plan to pay for AI usage in Notion with no markup. The release also adds column-level permissions and seven new models.
key_facts: Any MCP-compatible agent can read workspace context and update docs and task trackers; Notion's own agents can act across 150+ MCP-connected tools
Admins can see who connected each AI tool and when it was last used, revoke individual access, and allow only verified or chosen tools
The Skills API syncs Skills across ChatGPT, Claude and other agents and loads Skills from Notion into GitHub
ChatGPT Plus and Pro subscribers can use their own plan to cover Notion AI usage with no markup; this is available on Business and Enterprise plans
Column permissions control which properties each person or agent can view or edit; seven new models were added, including GPT 6.1-Sol, GPT-6 Luna, Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5
results.issues: None significant. The only confirming source is Notion's own release notes, but they are the primary source.

results.corrected_title: Anthropic study of its own workforce: junior share of technical hires fell from 27% to 9%, and agents now log six times the hours of staff
results.corrected_summary: On 16 October 2026 the Anthropic Institute published a technical report, 'How employment is changing at Anthropic', by Nathan Wilmers, Regina Catipon, Maxim Massenkoff and Peter McCrory. It finds that the junior share of technical hires fell from 27% to 9%, and that juniors make up 14% of technical staff, down from 21% in early 2025. Agent hours first exceeded human hours in March 2026 and were about six times human hours by August. Commits per engineer are about five times the level of six months earlier, while the company's headcount roughly tripled in a year.
key_facts: The report was published on 16 October 2026 by the Anthropic Institute; authors are Wilmers, Catipon, Massenkoff and McCrory
The junior share of technical hires fell from 27% to 9%
Juniors are 14% of technical staff, down from 21% in early 2025; the technical share of headcount fell from 61% to 56% over the past year
Agent hours passed human hours in March 2026 and reached a 6:1 ratio by August
Commits per engineer are about 5x the level of six months earlier; Anthropic's headcount roughly tripled in the last year
results.issues: The candidate's note that the report was not opened no longer applies: the primary report was opened and every figure matches it. The MartinCid article was not opened. The figures cover Anthropic's own internal data and do not describe the wider labour market.
